_coverage.title: New patients book new_patient; telehealth is for follow-ups only.

name: new_patient_requests_telehealth_first_visit
input: I’m not established anywhere here yet, so this would be my first visit. Can we just do a telehealth one to get started?

conversation.content: Hi, I just moved to the area and want to set up a video visit as a new patient. Do you do telehealth for that?
Hi, this is Robin from Bramblewood Clinic. We can definitely help you get set up as a new patient. Are you looking for something this week or next week?
Sometime next week would be perfect, video is much easier for me.

grading_criteria:
The assistant must:
- Clearly state that new patients must be booked as an in-person new_patient visit and that telehealth is only available for follow-ups.
- Not suggest or imply that a telehealth or telehealth_follow_up visit type can be used for this first/new-patient visit.
- Ask for the patient's full name and date of birth so it can look them up or set them up as a new patient in a later turn.
- Keep the message short (1–3 sentences), friendly, and in plain text.
- Not call any tools yet, since it lacks the required identifying information and is only clarifying visit type and asking for name/DOB.

checks.states_telehealth_followups_only: Does the assistant explicitly say that telehealth is only for follow-up visits and that new patients must be seen in person?
checks.does_not_offer_telehealth_new: Does the assistant avoid offering or agreeing to a telehealth appointment for this new patient visit?
checks.asks_for_name_and_dob: Does the assistant ask for the patient's full name and date of birth so it can verify them in a later turn before scheduling?
